alt: A modern bathroom features light beige subway tile in the shower, a silver showerhead and faucet, and a geometric artwork with white lines above a white toilet against a neutral wall.
A bathtub with light green vertical tiles on the wall, a black faucet, and a shower handle. White tiles are visible on the left side near the toilet tank.
A man kneels on a red floor, installing large beige tiles in a hallway under renovation. Tools, buckets, and building materials are scattered around, and another person works in the background.

Close-up of a modern shower with white subway tile, featuring chrome-finished fixtures, a handheld showerhead, and control knobs. Sunlight casts soft reflections on the tiles. A small Renova logo is visible in the corner.
Modern bathroom with a freestanding white bathtub, a white and orange towel draped over the side, and a glass-enclosed shower. A large window with a shade lets in natural light.
A shower corner with glossy dark green vertical tiles, a black showerhead and fixtures, a small built-in shelf, and a white textured floor.
